limitations.detail: No REST OHLCV endpoint documented; candles.path refers to MCP gateway https://mcp.eterna.exchange/mcp (execute_code tool); SDK market data is getTickers/getOrderbook/getInstruments only â no kline/candle method exists
Full REST endpoint reference is 'TODO: Redoc' at docs.eterna.exchange; only Authentication, Webhooks/Events, Error catalogue, Versioning pages published
Auth is OAuth2 (ai-auth.eterna.exchange, scope mcp:full) or legacy long-lived Bearer API key; no HMAC signature scheme documented â adapter uses Authorization: Bearer header
/api/trading-pairs response field names undocumented; field_map omitted
Trading only via MCP SDK inside execute_code Deno sandbox (placeOrder Market with stopLoss, setLeverage, setTradingStop, closePosition, cancelOrder); no REST order endpoints documented
USDT-margined perpetual futures (200+ pairs) with isolated sub-account per agent; funding-rate values and leverage cap undocumented; spot is roadmap only
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
min_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 100000.0

price_band_pct not documented â no local price-band check (0)
qty_step not documented â using default 8
fee_pct 0.035 is the documented futures taker fee (maker 0.014%); no spot fee table (spot not launched)

rate limits not documented (only 'rate limiting handled by gateway') â min_gap_sec default 1.0
candle timeframe interval values not documented â identity tf_param_map used
